audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill / Teemo / Teemo / Skill / Skill / Teemo / Teemo. The packet chart is Teemo / Teemo / Sylas / Sylas / Sylas / Sylas / Sylas — a different lane entirely.
audit.why: Every one of the seven content whys argues the packet's version: whys[0] says Teemo owns level 1, whys[2] says 'your full kill pattern... all comes online here', whys[3] 'too much for his E poison', whys[4] 'he dies in one chain', whys[5] 'the sustain advantage is now decisive', whys[6] 'you still win the straight duel comfortably'. The tokens were the only thing disagreeing, and Sylas wins 53.5% over 443 games.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 moved to the packet chart as matched full+content pairs, with ratings adjusted to follow. Also moved diff from TRICKY 7/10 to FAVOURED 4/10 — a chart with Sylas taking five of seven rows and a 53.5% win rate cannot sit under a 'tricky' header. Carry threat stays at 6/10 because his shroom map control is real regardless of the duel.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never explains why Blinding Dart hurts Sylas specifically, and whys[2] and mid both describe 'E2 stun'.
audit.why: Petricite Burst arms off Sylas's OWN spell casts and is spent by his next basic attack — so every Chain Lash loads an empowered auto, and a blind is what makes that loaded charge land on nothing. That is the actual cost of eating a Blinding Dart. Abscond/Abduct has no stun in Riot's text or flags.
audit.corrected: Blind stops attacks, never spells: keep casting Chain Lash and Kingslayer straight through it, and time the loaded auto for after it expires.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t all treat Blinding Dart as a cooldown that changes with rank.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds at every rank — extra points buy blind duration, not a faster loop. So the trade window never shrinks as the lane goes on, which is good news the page does not deliver.
audit.corrected: Flat 7s, 680 range, all game. Restated from the mirror rather than re-derived.

audit.whatIsWrong: Guerrilla Warfare is never mentioned anywhere on the page, despite Sylas having no reveal in his kit.
audit.why: Riot text: he turns invisible standing still, and can enter and MAINTAIN invisibility while moving inside brush, then gains attack speed on reveal. Every brush on the lane and every jungle entrance is a potential ambush, and the Element of Surprise attack speed feeds Toxic Shot.
audit.corrected: Written into report[5].t. This matters more than the shroom warnings the page already gives, because it applies from level 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Move Quick is called a passive in two fields ('his Move Quick passive means chasing on foot is suicide', wants.foe[1]).
audit.why: It is a 14s ability with two halves: a passive move speed that BREAKS the moment an enemy champion or turret strikes him, and an active sprint that is not stopped by being struck. So one Chain Lash strips the passive half — the page's advice to fear his speed omits the counterplay sitting inside the same ability.
audit.corrected: Strike him once to break the passive speed, then commit. Fear the active sprint, not the passive.

audit.whatIsWrong: Toxic Shot is described only as 'his E poison' with no itemisation consequence.
audit.why: It is on-hit MAGIC damage over 4 seconds that scales with his attack speed, so armour reads the trade wrong — the answer is magic resist and cutting his attack speed windows, not stacking armour.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3].why is generic boilerplate on what is a genuinely distinct stage.
audit.why: Levels 4-5 are the last stretch before Noxious Trap exists, so the map is clean and the only thing between you and him is a flat 7s Blinding Dart.
audit.corrected: Named it as the pre-mushroom poke window, matching the mirror's framing.

notes: The chart and the prose on this page described two different matchups. All seven content whys say Sylas takes over from level 3 onward and wins the duel all game; the win[] and phases[].side tokens said Teemo won four of seven rows; the packet agrees with the prose. I moved six rows plus their ratings, and also moved diff/diffRating/tone, because leaving a TRICKY 7/10 header over a chart where Sylas takes five of seven rows just relocates the contradiction. That header change is the one judgement call here — flagged in questionsForUser. Best mechanical addition: Petricite Burst is armed by Sylas's own casts and spent by his next auto, so a blind does not just 'stop autos', it burns a charge you paid a spell for. Guerrilla Warfare was absent from the page entirely. Unverified and left alone: the mid paragraph's claim that the blind lasts 1.5 seconds — duration is not in the kit data.
